title: Motion Without State: Probing Dynamical Consistency and Conditioning Bias in Video Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.05135v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Image-to-video models serve as visual world priors whose plausible motion departs from physical simulation. We ask what dynamical structure replaces forward state propagation in generated motion, and how it biases quantitative physics evaluation. Holding law and initial state fixed, we vary visible geometry, prompt wording, and clip length across nine models and compare tracked trajectories against simulator rollouts. Generated motion splits into local visual cues and global boundary control, omitting the propagating physical state between them. Locally, tempo-normalized speed follows track undulations with a 15{\deg}-41{\deg} phase lead toward steepest descent as mean slope barely accelerates the ball, showing short memory of past slope. Local responses fail to compose: no single contact law describes a model's bounces (prescribed, self-calibrated on single-deflector contacts, or fitted in-sample), and balls clear 43 of 49 bar

translated_title: 无状态的运动：探究视频模型中的动力学一致性与条件化偏差
translated_abstract: 图像到视频模型作为视觉世界先验，其看似合理的运动偏离了物理仿真。我们探究在生成运动中是什么样的动力学结构取代了前向状态传播，以及它如何使定量物理评估产生偏差。在保持物理定律和初始状态不变的情况下，我们在九个模型上改变可见几何结构、提示词措辞和片段长度，并将跟踪得到的轨迹与模拟器推演结果进行对比。生成的运动分裂为局部视觉线索和全局边界控制两个层面，二者之间缺少传播中的物理状态。在局部层面，经节拍归一化的速度跟随轨道起伏，并以15°至41°的相位超前指向最陡下降方向，而平均坡度几乎无法加速小球，这表明模型对过去坡度的记忆十分短暂。局部响应无法组合：没有任何单一的接触定律能够描述模型的反弹行为（可能是预设的、在单个偏转器接触上自校准的，或是样本内拟合的），并且小球能够越过49个挡板中的43个……
tldr: 该研究发现图像到视频模型的生成运动缺乏物理状态的前向传播，仅由局部视觉线索和全局边界控制构成，这种动力学一致性的系统性缺失会显著偏置定量物理评估的结果。
en_tdlr: Image-to-video models generate motion without forward physical state propagation, splitting into local visual cues and global boundary control, revealing systematic dynamical inconsistencies that bias quantitative physics evaluation.
